system.description:
Cost: 1 Resolve

Range: 10 spaces

You rip away a piece of a creature's soul.

As an Action, choose a creature you can see within 10 spaces and make a 4:1 Soul (Metaphysics) check opposed by the target's Willpower. If the target is a spirit, demon, or sacred beast, it has Disadvantage on the check.

If you win, you hold a shard of the target's soul until the start of your next turn. While you hold it and the target is within 30 spaces of you:

  • You know which space the target occupies, even if you cannot see it.

  • When you make an attack with Mystwalker, or use an ability with the Mystwalker trait, you may measure its Range to the target as though the target were adjacent to you, and you need no line of sight to it.

You may spend 1 Resolve at the start of your turn to sustain this effect.
